text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, thank you for the wonderful, 
aromatic tea leaves this morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all, you're very welcome. By the 
way—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...When should I give them the other 
present, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I won the lottery. —Tickets for 
that match, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I-If possible, right away...! I want to 
lay my eyes on the real tickets this very 
second...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, roger that! I'll go grab it right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I haven't seen McQueen this hyped up in 
quite a while~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yutaka might break the all-time career 
home run record...!! There is no waaay I'm 
missing this~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (I'm so glad I gave it my all♪)
